body:
maria_support: raising issue from customer (BetaWare). They received an unexpected AWS marketplace charge for $3,600 on 2026-05-14 under SKU 'redwood-usage-v2' but our tenant usage shows only a small test project (120 tokens). Procurements is asking for details.

lee_billing: can you paste the invoice line and buyer id? need to see allocation/seller fields.

maria_support: customer attached invoice snippet: invoice_line_id aws-li-98765 | sku redwood-usage-v2 | amount 3600.00 | buyer_id arn:aws:marketplace:buyer:9876543210 | allocation_id alloc-222

toni_finance: quick thought: that amount seems like a monthly subscription SKU, not per-token usage. Did we recently rename subscription SKUs? Might be an alias collision.

devin_ops: I searched metering events for alloc-222:
```
SELECT count(*), sum(units) FROM marketplace_metering WHERE allocation_id='alloc-222' AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-15';
-- returns rows: count=1, sum(units)=3600000
```
Units look huge. But our usage ingestion normalizes units to tokens; wonder if a unit_multiplier was applied incorrectly during the alias migration.

metering_ingest: ingestion logs show a transform applied on 2026-05-10 at 03:12 UTC: sku_alias_map v3 deployed which included a factor_map for old subscription SKUs. The mapping for 'redwood-usage-v2' accidentally set multiplier=1000 for legacy records.

lee_billing: so marketplace metering event is real, but our accounting pipeline multiplied units by 1000 and then filtering logic excluded subscription SKUs from tenant attribution (we only attribute per-token SKUs). The result: AWS billed buyer for subscription (they did through marketplace), but our tenant usage table shows only tiny token count because we later dropped large unit rows. That explains mismatch.

maria_support: customer says they migrated accounts mid-April and consolidated billing. They expect we reassign the subscription charge to their current tenant account; procurement wants justification for any credits.

tonio_finance: (toni) proposed actions: 1) run a careful parse of raw metering payloads for alloc-222 and buyer 9876543210 to confirm raw units and timestamps; 2) correct ingestion multiplier in place and replay ingest; 3) if replay results in tenant attribution matching invoice, issue platform credit or marketplace adjustment depending on AWS policy; 4) notify customer.

devin_ops: I'll patch the alias map to set multiplier=1 and re-process raw events for the date range 2026-05-01..2026-05-15. Note: replay could create duplicate usage rows unless we mark reprocessed run_id. Will add dedupe key based on event_id.

lee_billing: also open a Seller Central case referencing aws-li-98765 for traceability. aws_mp_bot, can you open a support request and attach event ids?

aws_mp_bot: created AWS case 12345 referencing invoice_line aws-li-98765 and attached event ids: mevt-1101,mevt-1102. Case URL: https://sellercentral.aws/case/12345

maria_support: customer reply: "Please confirm ASAP, procurement will pause further purchases if unresolved." :grimacing:

toni_finance: decision: we will (A) replay and backfill correctly attributed usage and (B) issue a one-time credit for $3,600 while replay is in progress to avoid procurement blocking. Finance approves provisional credit pending final reconciliation.

lee_billing: drafting credit memo now. Will include note: provisional credit pending final reconciliation; will revert if AWS issues adjustment. Sharing to accounting list in ~2h.

devin_ops: replay started. ETA ~45m for backfill job to finish. Will tag logs when complete.

metering_ingest: backfill completed. Results: after replay, tenant_id=tenant-betaware now shows usage equivalent to a subscription charge of $3,600 for 2026-05-14. No duplicate records detected.

toni_finance: confirmed backfill aligns with invoice. Proceed with final credit memo issuance and mark case resolved on our side. We'll keep AWS case open for audit.

maria_support: emailed customer with summary and credit confirmation. They replied: "Thanks, please send invoice-level note for procurement. We'll re-enable purchasing after receipts come through." :white_check_mark:

devin_ops: postmortem items: (1) remove multiplier from alias map by default, require explicit review on alias updates; (2) add unit_goodness_check in ingestion to flag >1e6 units; (3) weekly reconciliation job between marketplace invoices and attributed tenant usage.

lee_billing: closing loop. credit memo #CM-2026-055 sent to billing@betaware.example. tagging @maria_support for closure.

participants: maria_support,lee_billing,toni_finance,devin_ops,aws_mp_bot,metering_ingest
